name: context-discovery/fixture-laravel-m1-vendor-installed
description: M1 fixture, variant C: the realistic Laravel application as it exists on a developer machine or in CI after `composer install` — its own psr-4 map declares App\ and nothing else, exactly like variant A, and the framework's namespaces are known only to Composer's generated vendor/composer/autoload_psr4.php. This is the environment M6 exists to serve: variant A is the same application before install, variant B simulates the map already being widened by hand.
